message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The migration `migrations/001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` was writing and reading `full_name`, so the insert failed with `unknown column users.full_name`. I changed `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname`. I didn't touch `migrations/`, since the DBA team owns it and it's already applied in production.
